description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amending the Medical Service Minufe of Sri Lankan Health Service Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1883/11 of 11.10.2014
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an amendment to the Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lankan Health Service, which deals with recruitment age criteria for medical officers. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and specifically addresses public service recruitment regulations and service conditions for healthcare professionals. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector service administration, recruitment rules, and compliance with Supreme Court orders regarding public service appointments.
